Theorem
[Injectivity Theorem] 1. chA:A.55[LeeTM, Thm. 11.16] If $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$ is a covering map, then for each point $\tilde{x} \in \tilde{M}$, the induced fundamental group homomorphism $\pi _*: \pi _1(\tilde{M}, \tilde{x}) \to \pi _1(M, \pi (\tilde{x}))$ is injective.
